sentences.en: We were amazed at the excellence of the boy's drawings.
sentences.zh: 我们对这个男孩绘画的卓越感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Tonight, we had fun drawing up our family tree together.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们一起绘制家谱图玩得很开心。

sentences.en: I was just drawing pictures, I had no further intention.
sentences.zh: 我只是在画画，并没有其他意图。
